decision: PHASE 09X CONTROLLED LOA ANSWER RUNTIME WIRING DESIGN PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS
objective: Create a design-only controlled runtime-wiring plan for a future implementation patch to safely answer the narrow live /ask query family "I received a BIR LOA, what should I do?" by routing through the closed Phase 9 scaffold stack (09L, 09M, 09O, 09P, 09Q, 09S) behind an intent guard and scope guard, without wiring anything to /ask, without activating runtime behavior, and without producing final legal conclusions or filing-ready output. This patch prepares PHASE-09Y-CONTROLLED-LOA-ANSWER-RUNTIME-WIRING-SCAFFOLD-1; it does not implement it.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: Intent guard
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Detect generic procedural LOA-help intent only, using a narrow LOA/eLA-received pattern; never widen to validity, finality, protest, or CTA-strategy phrasing.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: Scope guard
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Confirm the user is asking what to do after receiving a LOA/eLA, not asking for a final validity, protest, or CTA conclusion; route excluded intents to fallback.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: Authority-safe procedural fallback (09L)
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Use 09L authority-safe procedural fallback concepts to provide safe first steps when controlling authority cannot yet be confirmed.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: Notice triage (09M)
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Use 09M BIR notice/LOA triage intent concepts to classify original LOA/eLA, replacement eLA, consolidated eLA, checklist, notice for presentation, pre-subpoena reminder, TVN, Mission Order, or unknown notice.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: 2026 audit baseline signals (09S)
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Use 09S 2026 BIR audit baseline integration concepts to flag RMO No. 1-2026, RMO No. 6-2026, RMC No. 14-2026, RMC No. 5-2026, and related 2026 review signals when relevant.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: Document compliance plan (09P)
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Use 09P BIR document compliance/transmittal concepts for the document matrix, controlled transmittal, receiving proof, non-applicable/unavailable/non-existent documents, substitute proof, clarification requests, voluminous records, certified copies, and on-premise review.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: Audit defense matrix (09O)
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Use 09O BIR audit defense matrix concepts only as issue organization, never as a legal conclusion.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: Authority corpus requirement (09Q)
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Use 09Q BIR authority corpus research design concepts to state that official-source verification is required before any legal conclusion.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: Safe response renderer
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Produce a procedural-safe answer with no final legal conclusion, no filing-ready output, no automatic submission, and a preserved human review notice.

futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.title: Source-card discipline
futureRuntimeRoutingDesign.description: Use design/source-card references only unless a future implementation confirms verified source-card availability from the existing retrieval/SAE/source-card systems.

futureSafeResponseTemplate.templateText: If you received a BIR LOA/eLA, do not ignore it. First, preserve the date and manner of receipt and keep a clear copy of the notice and attachments. Check the LOA/eLA details: taxpayer name, TIN, taxable period, tax types covered, issuing office, LOA/eLA number, audit case number, Revenue Officer, Group Supervisor, approving/signing official, and the documents requested. Next, verify the LOA/eLA through the available BIR verification process where applicable, including the BIR REVIE / LOA Verifier process under RMC No. 5-2026 when relevant. Determine whether the document is an original eLA, replacement eLA, consolidated eLA, TVN, Mission Order, checklist, notice for presentation/submission, or pre-subpoena reminder. If it involves a replacement eLA, consolidated eLA, multiple eLAs for the same taxable year, VATAS/LTVAU, TVN scope, or additional document requests, treat it as a 2026 audit-framework review issue and verify against the applicable BIR issuances. Prepare a document compliance matrix. Classify each requested document as provided, to-follow, not applicable, unavailable, non-existent, substitute proof available, requires reconciliation, requires certified copy, requires on-premise review, or requires BIR clarification. Submit documents through controlled transmittal. Keep proof of submission, such as BIR receiving stamp, email acknowledgement, courier proof, attachment list, receiving office/officer, and date/time of submission. If a document is not applicable, unavailable, or does not exist, do not fabricate it. Prepare a factual explanation and, where appropriate, substitute proof such as management certification, affidavit, AFS note, tax return support, official record, or third-party confirmation. Avoid unnecessary admissions. Respond in writing when needed, preserve all defenses, and monitor possible next stages: additional document request, NOD/DOD, PAN, FAN/FLD, protest, FDDA, and CTA appeal-watch. This is procedural guidance only. Validity, prescription, finality, appealability, protest strategy, CTA strategy, and legal conclusions require official-source verification and human tax/legal review.
prohibitedResponsePatternCategories: claims that the LOA/eLA is valid or invalid
claims that the BIR cannot assess the taxpayer
claims that the notice may be safely disregarded
claims that the assessment has been resolved in the taxpayer's favor
assertions of a compliance deadline stated with unwarranted certainty

futureResponseModes.description: Default procedural-safe guidance for a plain original LOA/eLA receipt question.
Guidance branch for a replacement eLA scenario, routed through 09M/09S replacement-eLA signals.
Guidance branch for a consolidated eLA / multiple-eLA scenario, routed through 09M/09S/09O consolidation signals.
Guidance branch for a standardized checklist or document-request scenario, routed through 09P.
Guidance branch for a pre-subpoena or subpoena-adjacent reminder, routed through 09P with an escalation warning.
Guidance branch for a notice type that cannot be confidently classified, routed through 09L fallback.
Terminal mode for any excluded intent (validity/finality/protest/CTA/filing-ready/automatic-submission questions), routed to authority-safe procedural fallback and human tax/legal review.

futureSourceCardPolicy.policyStatement: Future runtime answers may cite or display source cards only if the source cards are verified by the existing retrieval/SAE/source-card systems. If verified cards are not available, the future answer must avoid legal citation phrasing, use procedural-safe language, state that official-source verification is required, and avoid any final authority claim.
